protocol_name: spatially-separated nested CV with inner F1-optimal threshold, untouched independent test
outer_fold_rule: 5 contiguous x-bands. Landslide pixels sorted by x, split into 5 near-equal contiguous chunks; band boundaries at midpoints between chunk extremes. Background pixels assigned to the band containing their x. Each band has >=4 positives.
inner_tuning_rule: Within each outer fold, the outer-training subset is evaluated with stratified 5-fold CV; F1-maximizing threshold over grid 0.01..0.99 (step 0.01) is selected from OOF probabilities. Threshold is applied to the outer held-out band. No information from the test set is used.
selection_rule: Model selection uses ONLY outer-CV aggregates on training data: primary = mean PR-AUC, tie-break = mean ROC-AUC, then mean F1 at inner-tuned thresholds.
final_evaluation_rule: One, and only one, evaluation on the untouched test set is performed AFTER the model and its operating threshold are frozen. The operating threshold for the final model is the F1-maximizing threshold computed on pooled out-of-fold probabilities across the 5 outer bands (training data only). Default T=0.5 metrics are also reported for transparency.
uncertainty_rule: Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (B=1000, seed 123) are computed for test ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision and recall at the frozen threshold. Bootstrap is descriptive; it is not used for tuning.
test_set_firewall: The 1,524-sample test set (25 landslide polygons) is not read, inspected, or used at any stage of model or threshold selection.
caveats: Training contains only 24 unique landslide polygons (1 pixel each); fold-level estimates will have high variance.
Folds with few positives make PR-AUC noisy; results are interpreted with this limitation explicitly.
Background pixels are not spatially contiguous groups (all polygon_id=-1); separation is enforced via x-bands only.
No susceptibility map is generated by this protocol.
